title: TrustedPeer
description: A row of the trusted_peers table (docs/protocol.md section 2). A token belongs to a peer; the phone stores only sha256(token), never the token itself. The Admin token (scopes ["*"], ceiling DESTRUCTIVE) is created on first run, stored in Keystore-backed encrypted preferences, and shown once in the UI; it is the only token that can call /pair issuance from the UI path.

token_sha256.description: sha256 of the random 32-byte base64url token; the phone never stores the raw token.

scopes.description: Capability globs, e.g. ["messaging.*", "device.get_*", "events.*"]. A scope's "*" matches within one dotted segment or, when the whole segment is "*", across segments; a bare "*" matches everything.

max_action_class.description: Ceiling: a tool is visible to this peer iff a scope matches AND the tool's action class <= this ceiling.

created_at.description: Epoch milliseconds. protocol.md groups created_at with the other three timestamp columns as nullable INTEGER; in practice this is always set.

revoked_at.description: Revoking a peer closes its WebSockets and ends its sessions within one second.
